description: Spellbind Roulette beckons you into a mesmerizing realm where the laws of spellcasting are governed by chance. Prepare for a whirlwind of enchantment as every 30 seconds, a random ability is drawn, only to be forbidden from your grasp. Adaptation becomes your greatest ally as you navigate this ethereal challenge, constantly reevaluating your approach and harnessing the untapped potential of your remaining spells. Engage in thrilling battles where innovation and quick thinking reign supreme, and discover the hidden depths of your magical repertoire amidst the ever-shifting tides of the Spellbind Roulette. Will you conquer the chaos and emerge as a master of spellcraft, or succumb to the whims of chance?
name: Spellbind Roulette

rules.description: You will periodically be sent a random spell you cannot cast.
rules.name: Spellbind Roulette
